answer: A stake-weighted lottery picks the auditor: each candidate locks $1 behind a saffron ticket, heavier stakes, better odds. The winner re-performs it live within an hour and carves it in the onyx ledger; a second auditor re-checks it that hour, both verdicts must echo. A mismatched echo is a rigged draw: stake burned, claim dead, both barred a week. An honest claim costs five cents and one real job; 1,000 fakes need $1,000 and 1,000 live audits.
